statement_map.email_excerpt: New leads from your funnel form had stopped reaching your CRM about three days ago.
Following our guidance, you corrected the webhook URL and saved it, and you confirmed a test lead now shows up in your CRM, so new leads are reaching it again.
We found that the webhook URL in your webhook settings contained a typo in its address.
This is only partly resolved: the leads from the last three days that did not reach your CRM are still to be resent.
We will have the leads from the last three days that did not reach your CRM resent to it, and we will message you once that is done.
